title: LocalGPT: Benchmarking and Advancing Large Language Models for Local Life Services in Meituan
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking LLMs for local life services such as dining, accommodation, and entertainment on the Meituan platform. While it mentions moral judgment in the Related Work section when referencing other studies, its own benchmark (LocalEval) focuses on service fundamentals, spatiotemporal context, and user-service interactions without any component evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
